name: Move tabs and groups
description: Move tabs and tab groups around using keyboard shortcuts. Extra utilities are included to pin/unpin and ungroup tabs.

move-tab-group-left.description: Move tab group to the left

move-tab-group-right.description: Move tab group to the right

move-tab-to-next-window.description: Move tab to the next window

move-tab-to-previous-window.description: Move tab to the previous window

move-tab-group-to-next-window.description: Move tab group to the next window

move-tab-group-to-previous-window.description: Move tab group to the previous window
